comment: Overrides for swiftpm-notices.py (run by bundle-notices.sh from the LLimitApp build phase). Every entry states why it exists. files paths are relative to this file.
preamble: LLimit's own code is released under the Unlicense (see LICENSE in the source
repository). The components below are compiled into LLimit.app and keep their
own licenses. The Swift runtime and system frameworks ship with macOS.

swift-argument-parser.reason: Pinned only because SwiftTerm 1.18.0's Termcast executable uses it (checked in SwiftTerm's Package.swift at 1.18.0); LLimitApp links the SwiftTerm library product, whose target has no dependencies.

components.name: Unicode Character Database tables in SwiftTerm
components.reason: SwiftTerm compiles tables generated from the UCD (UnicodeWidthData.swift, Apple/ArabicShapingData.swift, Apple/BidiMirroringData.swift), which fall under the Unicode License V3 (https://www.unicode.org/license.txt) that SwiftTerm's MIT LICENSE does not include. A separate component rather than add_files, so SwiftTerm still fails the build if its own LICENSE goes missing.
